message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Customer Concentration Ratio", "construction": "Sum the percentage of total revenue derived from the firm's top 3 customers, as disclosed in annual filings (10-K).", "rationale": "Firms highly dependent on a few customers may face higher cash flow risk, which could be priced in expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Intensity", "construction": "Number of new patents granted in the past fiscal year divided by total assets, using USPTO data and firm disclosures.", "rationale": "Firms with intense patent activity may signal innovation and future growth potential not captured by traditional measures.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Quarterly Earnings Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly earnings per share (EPS) over the past 8 quarters.", "rationale": "High earnings volatility may indicate risk or mispricing associated with informational uncertainty.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Insider Net Purchase Ratio", "construction": "Total shares bought minus shares sold by insiders over the past 12 months, divided by shares outstanding, using SEC Form 4 filings.", "rationale": "Net insider buying may reflect private information about future firm performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Segment Revenue Diversification", "construction": "1 minus the Herfindahl index of revenue by business segment, calculated from segment disclosures in annual reports.", "rationale": "Firms with more diversified revenue streams may be more resilient and less exposed to idiosyncratic shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Year-over-year percentage change in total employees as reported in the 10-K filing.", "rationale": "Rapid hiring may signal expansion and positive firm outlook not yet priced by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Turnover Change", "construction": "Change in the ratio of quarterly sales to short-term assets (cash + receivables + inventory) over the past 4 quarters.", "rationale": "Improving efficiency in using short-term assets could foreshadow higher profitability and returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Omission Signal", "construction": "Binary variable equal to 1 if the firm omitted a regular dividend in the most recent quarter, 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "Dividend omissions may indicate financial distress and risk, which could be associated with higher future returns if markets overreact.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Ratio", "construction": "Deferred tax assets divided by total assets, from balance sheet data.", "rationale": "A high proportion of deferred tax assets might signal aggressive accounting or anticipation of future losses, potentially linked to risk and return.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Sustained CapEx Reduction", "construction": "Percent decrease in capital expenditures over the last 3 years, provided it is a reduction in each consecutive year.", "rationale": "Extended cuts in capital spending may indicate underinvestment and neglected firms, which could be undervalued.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
